text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Ehhhh! Why can't I play it~!

One day, while passing by an arcade, I 
heard a loud voice coming from in front of 
a dance game.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask... It says so right here. 
'Suspended due to low player count. 
Scheduled to be replaced with 
next-generation cabinets'... apparently.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Muuu~. But I wanted to show McQueen how 
cool I look playing it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What sort of motive is that, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, it cannot be helped. Why not 
try playing a different game instead?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...No way. I'm gonna go talk to the 
manager!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—So that's why, on the condition that 'I 
hype up the game's popularity', he said 
it's totally okay to play!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, you do the livestreaming, okay! 
If everyone sees me dancing, they'll 
totally wanna play it too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait just a moment! What do you mean, 
'So that's why'?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Like I said~ The manager said, 'It's 
suspended 'cause it's not popular, but if 
you can make it popular, feel free to use 
it.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you simply pushed your own 
selfishness through, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Is being selfish so bad? It's way better 
than doing nothing, and it helps out this 
arcade too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's such a waste that nobody 
knows about a game this fun! Let's show it 
off and get everybody hyped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...So it is not mere selfishness after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I shall assist you. ...So then, 
how does one operate a livestream?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Yo, hop!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, is it filming properly~? How's it 
looking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is recording fine... Everything is 
fine— Wait, there are already nearly 5,000 
viewers gathered?! And the comments are 
pouring in!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, hey everyone~! Today I'm gonna show 
off my absolute favorite dance game, so 
stick around and enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap~!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...?! When did an entire crowd gather 
behind us...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for cheering me on, everyone~! 
Since you're here, you should totally give 
this game a spin too!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want to play! Teio-chan looked like 
she was having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text: I wanna go next too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Mission super-duper accomplished♪

text_block_list.name: Arcade Manager
text_block_list.text:
—Man, you two! I never imagined you'd 
actually get people this hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely keep it running for a 
while longer! Even though it's active in 
other arcades, thank you so much for 
choosing our place...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on a moment. Was this game 
operating at other locations?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If so, wouldn't it have been simpler to 
just go there instead of negotiating and 
filming here...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That wouldn't work! Because right now, at 
this place, I wanted to play this game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To cause such a massive stir purely for 
that reason... You truly are... the 
'Emperor'.
